overview: Same idea for 2D physics. A separate component rather than a mode, because Unity's 2D trigger callbacks are different methods — one class cannot serve both without reflection or duplication.
useCases: Pickup and hazard zones in a 2D game.

gotchas.title: 2D and 3D triggers do not interact
gotchas.body: A Collider2D never fires a 3D callback or the reverse. Mixing them in one scene is the usual reason a trigger seems dead.
